title: Composition of normalized tensor comparisons and their models
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, f:X→Y and g:Y→Z arbitrary scheme maps, and s a finite exponent or the whole ringed sequence site. Fix closed derived tensor structures A,B,C and representative models TA,TB,TC, and three BundledTensorComparisons Kf,Kg,Kh for f,g,fg [lem-sf-ambient-tensor-data-exists-unique]. Assume their ordinary generator formulas, naturality, chain invertibility and preservation of flat-term K-flat representatives (Normalized), and the scalar generator composition equation for the specified module compositor. Then the ordinary tensor square for Kf,Kg,Kh commutes, the displayed inverse total-chain square commutes on flat-term K-flat pairs, and the derived tensor square commutes for all unbounded inputs. Explicitly the derived equation is P_f(mu_g);mu_f;(d tensor d)=d;mu_fg. All three equations are on the original ringed site, including arbitrary semilinear horizontal transitions.

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 03EL; sites.tex 03CB; sites-cohomology.tex 06YN, 06YS, 07A4, 0G7E and 0G7D. Specialized construction and proof from the ambient coherence argument.

proof.text: Apply injectivity of the composite module adjunction hom-equivalence, then extensionality on sheafified pure tensors. Evaluate at the two base-changed objects using the identity arrows and unit scalars. Naturality of each adjunction unit commutes the ordinary comparison with its inverse-image generator. The two normalized tensor formulas and tensor-morphism action on pure sections identify the first route. Apply the supplied generator-composition equation to both tensor factors and to the original pure tensor. The normalized composite tensor formula identifies the second route. Structural ring maps preserve 1, so the two sections agree.

Apply the proved general tensorComparisonComposition theorem to the three ambient inverse-image functors and their ordinary compositor, using the ordinary square just established. Its chain equation holds for all complexes, hence in particular on flat-term K-flat pairs. Its derived equation is precisely the ambient derived square, because the ambient chain and derived compositors are the canonical exact-functor compositors. The generic proof tests total summands, pastes representative equations and extends by rigidity; no new resolution choices or data are introduced.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03D3 and 03EL, with sites-cohomology.tex 06YN and 07A4; explicit adjunction-unit calculation and representative-model pasting using existing proved helpers. The unit route and all statements are unchanged.

theorem normalizedTensor_composition {X Y Z : Scheme.{t}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (s : Option ℕ)
    (A : Tensor ell E Z s) (B : Tensor ell E Y s) (C : Tensor ell E X s)
    (TA : TensorModels ell E Z s A) (TB : TensorModels ell E Y s B)
    (TC : TensorModels ell E X s C)
    (Kf : TensorData ell E f s B C TB TC) (Kg : TensorData ell E g s A B TA TB)
    (Kh : TensorData ell E (f ≫ g) s A C TA TC)
    (_hKf : Kf.Normalized ell E f s B C TB TC)
    (_hKg : Kg.Normalized ell E g s A B TA TB)
    (_hKh : Kh.Normalized ell E (f ≫ g) s A C TA TC)
    (_hgen : (∀ (M : Modules ell E Z s) (U : Site Z s) (V : Site Y s) (W : Site X s)
      (p : V ⟶ (base g s).obj U) (q : W ⟶ (base f s).obj V)
      (m : M.val.obj (op U)) (a : (coefficients ell E Y s).obj.obj (op V))
      (b : (coefficients ell E X s).obj.obj (op W)),
      ((comp ell E f g s).hom.app M).val.app (op W)
          (generator ell E f s ((pull ell E g s).obj M) V W q
            (generator ell E g s M U V p m a) b) =
        generator ell E (f ≫ g) s M U W
          (q ≫ (base f s).map p ≫ (baseComp f g s).inv.app U) m
          (scalar ell E f s V W q a * b))) :
    (∀ (M N : Modules ell E Z s),
      (pull ell E f s).map (Kg.model.ordinary M N).hom ≫
          (Kf.model.ordinary
            ((pull ell E g s).obj M) ((pull ell E g s).obj N)).hom ≫
          tensorHom ell E X s ((comp ell E f g s).hom.app M)
            ((comp ell E f g s).hom.app N) =
        (comp ell E f g s).hom.app (tensor ell E Z s M N) ≫
          (Kh.model.ordinary M N).hom) ∧
    (∀ P Q : CochainComplex (Modules ell E Z s) ℤ,
      FlatRepresentative ell E Z s P → FlatRepresentative ell E Z s Q →
      (total ell E X s).map (Prod.mkHom (chainComp ell E f g s P)
          (chainComp ell E f g s Q)) ≫
          Kh.model.chain P Q =
        Kf.model.chain
            (((pull ell E g s).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((pull ell E g s).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
          ((pull ell E f s).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
            (Kg.model.chain P Q) ≫
          chainComp ell E f g s ((total ell E Z s).obj (P, Q))) ∧
    ∀ F G : Derived ell E Z s,
      (derivedPull ell E f s).map (Kg.mu.hom.app (F, G)) ≫
          Kf.mu.hom.app
            ((derivedPull ell E g s).obj F, (derivedPull ell E g s).obj G) ≫
          C.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((derivedComp ell E f g s).hom.app F)
            ((derivedComp ell E f g s).hom.app G)) =
        (derivedComp ell E f g s).hom.app (A.tensor.obj (F, G)) ≫
          Kh.mu.hom.app (F, G)
